legs.name: estate-guard
legs.note: ESTATE ASSERTION, NOT THIS REPOSITORY'S. A red here names a SUBJECT repository and the seat who ruled its obligation, and that subject is usually not this repo -- this battery is only the clock. Take it to the named seat; do not delete this leg because it inconvenienced your landing. It asserts two things per listed row: that the repository carries refs/guards/shared-tree (the promise) and that the class-A guard is installed there as ruled (the mechanism). The population comes from docs/tracking/must-be-claimed.tsv, never from this repo. The trailing root runs the REVERSE arm (claimed but unlisted) -- without it, claim-without-listing then unclaim is a complete bypass of the witness, and it costs ~38s. PORTABILITY, 2026-08-20: this leg used to name a macOS absolute path and exited 127 on Linux, recording SILENT while enforcing nothing -- measured on rocketfish during the aion#84 re-gate. It now invokes scripts/estate-guard.sh tree-relatively. That shim carries NO logic of its own: it locates the single canonical 945-line gate and hands over, because a tree-local COPY is Finding 22's exact shape. Where the estate ledger is unreachable it EXITS 2 (unmeasured, per the canonical gate's own contract) rather than 127-as-silent -- a red on such a box is TRUE, not inconvenient. Set ABLATIVE_ROOT to a checkout of the estate, or have the obligation re-ruled; do not soften the leg.
